items.title: AI-driven, large-scale nation-state campaign using ARTEX enables supply chain compromise
items.summary: Storm-0940 used ARTEX agentic AI to accelerate a ConnectWise supply chain compromise, enabling application credential abuse across Microsoft 365 environments. The post AI-driven, large-scale nation-state campaign using ARTEX enables supply chain compromise appeared first on Microsoft Security Blog .
items.title_ru: Крупномасштабная государственная кампания на основе искусственного интеллекта с использованием ARTEX позволяет компрометировать цепочку поставок

items.title: Two critical RCEs in PHP core
items.summary: Two critical remote code execution vulnerabilities in PHP core could have implications across its wider ecosystem. Talos has published a blog to explain what we know so far, and details the Snort coverage available, including rules in the Community Ruleset.
items.title_ru: Два критических RCE в ядре PHP

items.title: A Journey into Claude's Sandbox
items.summary: What started as a question about Claude’s sandbox turned into a connected investigation of container internals, process memory, and authorization tokens. Bishop Fox researcher Chris Davis documents what Claude revealed, what it handed over, and what that means for defense in depth.
